Cause: Missing, incorrect, inconsistent, or outdated customer information.
Potential_Impact: Unreliable predictions and incorrect customer risk assessments.
Mitigation: Apply data validation, quality checks, and regular data reviews.

Cause: Changes in customer characteristics or behavior over time.
Potential_Impact: Incoming data may differ from the data used during model training.
Mitigation: Monitor feature distributions and investigate detected drift.

Cause: Changes in customer behavior or relationships between features and churn.
Potential_Impact: Reduced prediction quality and missed churn cases.
Mitigation: Monitor performance when actual outcomes become available and evaluate retraining when necessary.

Cause: Unequal model performance across different customer groups.
Potential_Impact: Some customer groups may receive less reliable predictions.
Mitigation: Evaluate model performance across relevant customer groups and investigate disparities.

Cause: Unauthorized access, exposure, or inappropriate use of customer information.
Potential_Impact: Exposure of personal information and potential harm to customers.
Mitigation: Apply access controls, data minimization, and secure data handling procedures.

Cause: Business users treating predictions as final decisions.
Potential_Impact: Inappropriate customer retention actions without sufficient human review.
Mitigation: Require human review for important decisions and communicate model limitations.

Potential_Impact: Unauthorized access to models, customer data, or system components.
Mitigation: Implement authentication, role-based access control, and security reviews.
